content:
maria: Quick thread: proposal to add an "inspect samples" surface with per-route sampling, redaction-band display, and retry/dedupe protections. Goal: make real failures visible without increasing PII risk.

igor: high level: what are the streams? one or two?

maria: single pipeline. tag each sample with badge=INSPECT or ARCHIVE and a redaction_band (LOW/MED/HIGH). INSPECT -> Console ephemeral view (24h) w/breakglass. ARCHIVE -> encrypted audit store, strict RBAC.

selena: defaults? we should be conservative. text-only routes get a tiny default (0.005%); anything that accepts files/embeddings is opt-out until tenant explicitly requests opt-in.

vik: infra notes: must protect against retry storms. sampling should be applied after dedupe by request fingerprint (dedupe window default 5m). retries of same request_id must not generate extra samples. add a request-id header rule.

compliance-bot: policy-scan: route /v1/attachment_upload sensitivity=0.97 -> auto-opt-out applied.

maria: good. also add per-org monthly sample caps and an org-level emergency kill-switch that sets inspect rates to 0 immediately. Console should show a prominent banner when the kill-switch is active.

igor: UX: show an inline microcard next to route config: "inspect: 0.005% (text) • archive: 0.0005%" and a tiny histogram for redaction_band distribution. Avoid showing raw float confidence; use band labels and reason tags ("email", "credit-like", "ocr").

selena: viewing an INSPECT sample requires breakglass justification (free-text, max 200 chars) and MFA for high-sensitivity tenants. Store (actor, justification, time) in immutable audit log. INSPECT view TTL = 24h.

vik: cost estimator: Console should show projected samples/month and token delta before committing rate changes. Formula: samples/month = recent_30d_requests * sampling_rate; cost = samples/month * avg_tokens * token_price. If projected cost > org quota, require approval.

maria: add regression hook: feed a subset of archived samples to Optimize evals weekly to detect scrub failures or over-scrubbing. Alert on >X% regression.

igor: config sketch for infra/product alignment (informal):
"route=/v1/chat/stream; inspect_rate=5e-05; archive_rate=5e-06; redaction_display=banded; attachments=opt_out; dedupe_ttl=300"

selena: security caveat: do not surface raw pre-scrub payloads for MED band by default. Show pre/post diffs only for HIGH band or when tenant opt-in to diffs. Document that in tenant opt-in flow.

vik: implement enforcement order: global_kill_switch > org_cap > tenant_override > route_override. Also add monitoring: inspect_samples_emitted, inspect_views, archive_samples_emitted, redaction_band_counts by route.

compliance-bot: compliance-note: ensure archive retention and export controls respect tenant SLAs and legal holds.

maria: next steps: I'll write a short RFC and a tiny Console mock. Infra owner: @vik (kill-switch, dedupe, caps). Product/UI: @igor for badge and cost preview. Compliance/security: @selena for opt-in wording and MFA gating. I'll post RFC link here once ready.

igor: :thumbsup: also add a small note on how tenants request attachments opt-in (legal justification + product review).

selena: will prepare the opt-in template and list of route patterns requiring legal sign-off.

maria: thanks all  will drop links into this thread when the RFC and prototype PRs are open.
